ranking: descriptive mean of within-13-gene percentile ranks for -log10(interaction padj) and absolute KO effect difference (minus_FBS - plus_FBS); weights 50/50; NOT a validated prediction model
ranking_scope: Only 13 post-selected OXPHOS genes, not all candidate genes
promoter_policy: Promoter signal descriptive only; not ranked because matched-background comparisons did not support consistent enrichment
caveats: HAP1 -FBS serum starvation differs from HeLa cholesterol depletion
No ChIP peak or binding-specific control validation
Gene-level interaction FDR does not prove significance of each condition-specific fold change
Ranking does not measure direct binding or mitochondrial function
Promoter measurements may reflect technical factors
Pathway membership and gene directions are selection criteria, not independent validation
Matched comparison summary applies to the set, not individual genes
